intent: Multi-line text entry for notes and descriptions. Wrap with Field.
useWhen: Inside Field when label, hint, or error are required
doNotUseWhen: Rich text or markdown editing — out of scope

rows.note: optional native rows; height also comes from size

value.note: controlled. When set, do not also rely on defaultValue.

requirements: Must have associated label via Field
Disabled uses native disabled and does not resize

doNot: Do not bake Field label or hint into Textarea — wrap with Field
Do not add start/icon slots — those are Input
snippet: <Field label="Notes" htmlFor="notes"><Textarea id="notes" size="md" placeholder="Add a note..." /></Field>
